import time import pytest from mistune.toc import render_toc_ul def test_render_toc_ul_ordered_single(): """AC-FR-001-1: Given TOC items [(1, 'toc_1', 'Introduction')], when render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True), then correct
    HTML.""" toc_items = [(1, 'toc_1', 'Introduction')] result = render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True) expected = "
      \n
    1. Introduction
      2. \n
    \n" assert result == expected def test_render_toc_ul_ordered_nested(): """AC-FR-001-2: Given nested TOC items [(1, 'toc_1', 'One'), (2, 'toc_2', 'Sub')], when render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True), then correct nested
      HTML.""" toc_items = [(1, 'toc_1', 'One'), (2, 'toc_2', 'Sub')] result = render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True) expected = ( "
        \n" "
      1. One\n" "
          \n" "
        1. Sub
          2. \n" "
        \n" "
        2. \n" "
      \n" ) assert result == expected def test_render_toc_ul_performance_threshold(): """AC-NFR-001-1: Execution time must be < 5ms for 1000 TOC items.""" toc_items = [(1 if i % 2 == 0 else 2, f"toc_{i}", f"Title {i}") for i in range(1000)] # Warm up render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True) start_time = time.perf_counter() # Run multiple iterations or single run measuring time iterations = 10 for _ in range(iterations): render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True) end_time = time.perf_counter() avg_duration_ms = ((end_time - start_time) / iterations) * 1000 assert avg_duration_ms < 5.0, f"Average execution time {avg_duration_ms:.2f}ms exceeded 5ms threshold for 1000 TOC items"
